Hi Joaquin —

Welcome — happy to get this moving. Short answers up front:

- Preferred: portal upload (https://app.invoicely.com/portal/invite/ProcureCo) for automated ingestion.

I copied Karthik (procurement ops) to confirm mapping and Marcus (billing) will send our official template and a copy of the PO. Please confirm whether you need a VAT/GST line or company-specific tax fields.

Hi all —

Sorry for the slight delay. Attaching our standard invoice template (procureco_invoice_template_v2.xlsx) and a PDF copy of PO_2026-12345. We can accept both portal uploads and emailed PDFs during vendor onboarding, but portal uploads are automatically ingested and matched to the PO (fewer manual steps).

Required fields for automated processing (please ensure these exact headers or map them in your system):
- Invoice Number
- Invoice Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- PO Number (must match PO_2026-12345)
- Line Item Description, Quantity, Unit Price, Line Total
- Subtotal, Tax (if applicable), Total Amount
- Vendor Tax ID / VAT Number
- Remit To (Redwood Inference, 2121 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103)
- Currency (USD)

If ProcureCo sends VAT as separate line items, our ingestion accepts either a single Tax total or separate VAT line, as long as you include a numeric tax field that sums correctly to the invoice total.

Portal invite link (one-time account creation): https://app.invoicely.com/portal/invite/ProcureCo — Joaquin, click that link and let us know the user emails for your AP team.

Filename recommendation for emailed PDFs: PO_2026-12345_Invoice_<InvoiceNumber>.pdf — that helps our ingestion rules.

Attachments: PO_2026-12345.pdf, procureco_invoice_template_v2.xlsx

Let me know if you want a 15-minute screen-share to walk through the portal.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
